descriptionHtml:
Bug B16 · P1 · new

Hospital pre-round: a line typed just before going offline is lost for good once the app is closed (Nursing Home recovers it)

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S28 A draft kept on the phone vs a later edit on the computer: restored when nobody edited, and per Q11 when the computer did

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything. (UAT TC-25 step 3; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 11; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T2 Edits made on one device (not only add, generate and delete) show on the other in real time, with no refresh. (TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital. (UAT TC-25 step 6; UAT TC-25; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Persistent phone context. The phone typed F into {hospitalPatient}'s pre-round notes, went setOffline(true) before the 800 ms autosave, and its page was closed, so the draft is kept in IndexedDB. Offline here only triggers the draft; it is not offline queuing

When (a) The computer saves G into the same field before the phone reopens. (b) The computer makes no edit. Then the phone goes online and reopens the chart. Run in both modes

Then (b) F is restored on the phone and reaches the computer. (a) The phone's words are kept or shown, or dropped only if Daniela allows it (Q11)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Scripted. (b) the phone page, then the computer page (no reload, within 10 s), contain 'QA-SYNC-PR-F', and the IndexedDB draft row is gone once the server echoes it. (a) record what the phone shows, the stored field (read-only adminQuery) and the IndexedDB draft row. …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog; TFA-94745 ready for qa

In the Hospital pre-round editor, a line typed just before the phone loses signal is lost for good once the app is closed, while the same thing in Nursing Home is restored.

Evidence: allure-results/322c0fd1…: Hospital pre-round writes no device copy while offline (0 rows at +0.3–3 s), so a line typed inside the 800 ms autosave window is gone after the page closes. NH restores it. Leg (a), where the computer's later edit drops the phone's text silently, is recorded only (Q11). This breaks EFS 'nothing typed is lost' (TFA-94745 AC 3). Not in the dev report, ledger or knownGaps.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: probes.

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S28

A draft kept on the phone vs a later edit on the computer: restored when nobody edited, and per Q11 when the computer did

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

New local lane probes: status failed in probes/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: yes): sync-probe both modes, legs a/b: phone types F into pre-round, goes offline inside the 800 ms autosave so only the device copy keeps it, page closed (context kept); (a) computer saves G; phone back online, new page, reopen: (b) F restored on phone and computer within 10 s, draft row gone; (a) recorded per Q11. [Review 2026-10-14] Probe: every put/delete on the draft store (key, navigator.onLine) is recorded via an init script, to tell 'no session / null draftId' from 'copy written then deleted'. — Context-level IndexedDB survives a page close; setOffline is Playwright.

Detail:

Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). NH: going offline inside the 800 ms autosave keeps a device copy (one put, no delete); (b) F is restored on the phone and reaches the computer, draft row gone after the echo; (a) the computer's later G wins and F is dropped silently (record-only, Q11). Hospital: the probe (every put/delete on the draft store, init script) shows the copy IS written with a valid key while offline (so the session / draftId is not null) and deleted 4–7 ms later, still offline, while the server never had F; after the page closes F is gone: (b) neither the phone, the computer nor the server has it; (a) G shown, F gone. Cause, from the probe + code: Hospital saves through rounding.update with an optimistic update (src/routes/rounding/Patient.tsx:33) that patches the local chart at once, so useAutosave's 'server echoed my text' check (src/lib/useAutosave.ts:101-110) fires locally and deletes the copy before anything reached the server; Nursing Home saves without one and keeps the copy. That path is local and does not depend on how the network is cut, so it should hold on a real phone in airplane mode — still worth one device check.

Product issue: Hospital pre-round (and every Hospital autosave field that saves through the same optimistic rounding.update): a line typed just before the phone loses signal (within the 0.8 s autosave) is lost if the app is closed before the signal returns — on reopening, the pre-round notes and the computer show nothing of it, while the same flow in Nursing Home restores it. The device copy is written and then deleted at once by the local optimistic echo (Patient.tsx:33 + useAutosave.ts:101-110), before the server has the text. Breaks Empty & Failure States 'nothing typed is lost' (TC-25 S28 b).

Evidence: 6 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — sync-probe (scripted, not written yet): two createAuthSession contexts (local admin key), a persistent phone context set offline before the autosave, and a read-only adminQuery of preRoundNotes; on dev the runner never signs in and has no admin key, so as designed it runs on the local stack only …. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
